status: post-evaluation descriptive diagnostic; not pre-registered forecasting or causal analysis
focus: current-PQ evaluation residuals; other partitions described for context, no fit or model selection
ranking: absolute residual descending, native origin index ascending for ties; post-hoc exemplars, not random or independent events
threshold_status: engineering descriptive cutoff chosen after baseline evaluation, not failure/selection/physical limit
logged_pq_age: origin index minus start index of current uninterrupted Mode_PQ=1 run, only observed prefix; zero means first logged PQ row; left-censored start retained and marked
age_group_status: post-hoc descriptive groups after inspecting first three residual cases; not an independent confirmatory test
signed_identity: Set(t)-AC(t+1) = [Set(t)-Set(t+1)] + [Set(t+1)-AC(t+1)]; algebraic differences, not causal attribution; absolute terms do not add
forward_context: first |AC|>50kW in next 10 logged seconds is illustrative only, not receipt-to-action latency; future commands may change
reporting: disjoint age group counts, pooled MAE, absolute residual sum share, large residual rate and future-change overlaps; primary daily-equal baseline metric retained
prohibited: claim physical delay or fault mechanism
upgrade diagnostic age groups to verified causal factors
source_and_outputs: verify original source and all frozen baseline artifact hashes before and after; new diagnostic results local only
